description:
Yoshiko Hanabatake is an idiot beyond all belief. Somehow managing to consistently score zeroes on all of her tests and consumed by an absurd obsession with bananas, her senseless acts have caused even her own mother to lose all hope. Only one person is up to the task of keeping her insanity in check: childhood friend Akuru "A-kun" Akutsu.

Though he bemoans the ridiculous behavior he has to endure, the studious but terrifying A-kun is always ready to put an end to any stupidity Yoshiko gets up to, with no qualms about using physical force. Unfortunately, no matter how many times he attempts to knock some sense into her, the girl bounces right back to her usual shenanigans, even dragging in some other eccentrics along for the ride. Try as he might to rein in her nonsense, every moment is unpredictable with Yoshiko and her profound idiocy on the loose.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

node.description:
**Height:** 160 cm

She is a high school girl who is stupid both academically and socially. She even gets zeroes on multiple choice tests.

Yoshiko is a complete crack head that is addicted to bananas, to put it simply. She is an incredibly eccentric person who is also very annoying towards [Akuru Akutsu](https://anilist.co/character/121875/Akutsu-Akuru), even though she truly wants him to love her. Yoshiko even goes so far as to let him see her panties. [Yoshie Hanabatake](https://anilist.co/character/121879/Hanabatake-Yoshie) even goes as far as to beg Akuru to be her boyfriend. Her idiotic actions towards Akuru caused her to get beat up by him. Akuru went as far as to punch her so high in the air it literally knocked her out. She downright annoys him. As a result of stupidity, her social skills are beyond abysmal, and generally makes the worst first impressions.
Yoshiko is quite perverted, as she enjoys groping the disciplinary committee president's breasts, has sneaked into Akuru's room and started sleeping around him, and likes to peek in the men's room just to see Akuru.

As a child, she showed a strong proclivity towards great agility and speed. She is strong for a girl despite her petite stature, as when she carried Akuru with little to no effort above her head when they were children. She can jump from one balcony to another, and is shown to have fast reflexes, with the exception of Akuru’s fast punches.

__Height:__ 175 cm

He is a smart and serious high school student who is constantly annoyed by [Yoshiko](https://anilist.co/character/121874/Hanabatake-Yoshiko)'s antics. He is Yoshiko's neighbor, childhood friend, and classmate.

Akuru is an intelligent and serious high school student who is forced to deal with Yoshiko Hanabatake’s stupidity. Though only interested in studying, he is unwittingly dragged into many of Yoshiko’s escapades much to his dismay.

Throughout the series, Akuru is seen as the straight man, constantly dealing with the eccentric personalities of those around him (especially Yoshiko) and is quick to make rude remarks. He is very upfront about his disgust for Yoshiko, often resorting to physical violence whenever she annoys him.

Despite this, Akuru is said to be strange himself as he is completely antisocial, having few friends due to his abrasive attitude. The only people Akuru gets along with is [Sayaka Sumino](https://anilist.co/character/121877/Sumino-Sayaka) and [Dog](https://anilist.co/character/121880/Inu) who are the only beings besides him to have sense.

Sayaka is Akuru and Yoshiko's classmate who ends up becoming friends with the two. She is level-headed and assumes the straight-man role, often moderating interactions between Yoshiko and others.

Sayaka is kind and worries about being boring. She is very sensitive, especially when others point out her small chest, which appears slightly small, even after she pads it. She sometimes loses her patience. Most people acknowledge her kind aura and the binding and relaxing effect it has on everyone.

The perverted mother of Yoshiko Hanabatake, who desperately wants Yoshiko to be normal or find a husband so Yoshie can retire. She is very skilled in hand-to-hand combat and can tell a woman's intentions by looking at her panties.

Yoshie is not an idiotic person like Yoshiko as Yoshie wishes for Yoshiko to be a normal person. She is shown to be rather devious schemer, as she longs to be free of her idiot daughter and retire happily. To do this, she hopelessly tries to set Yoshiko up with Akuru, who wants absolutely nothing to do with her in the future. She is willing to stoop to deprave methods to assure this, such as trying to find ways to get Yoshiko to "seal the deal" with Akuru to ensure he'll marry her in the future once he gets a well-paying job. The extent of her immorality is best shown when she encouraged her daughter to drug Akuru and then "seal the deal" with him after leaving him vulnerable, showing just how far her depravity goes.

Like her daughter, she is rather dirty-minded.

A big dog that [Yoshiko](https://anilist.co/character/121874/Hanabatake-Yoshiko) takes a liking to. Later on, it becomes her pet.

~!Dog is also given the name "George" by [Akuru](https://anilist.co/character/121875/Akutsu-Akuru)!~

Ryuuichi Kurosaki is a delinquent guy whom Yoshiko Hanabatake interacts with and he becomes her disciple, calling her big sister. When Ryuuichi first appeared, he was shown to be just your typical delinquent. However, after meeting Yoshiko Hanabatake and Akuru Akutsu, he became a lot nicer and shows his idiotic side more.

Akuru's little sister who is in the fifth grade.

Ruri is a hardworking elementary school student who devotes her time to studying and she is determined to become smart and dependable. Despite this, she utterly fails at nearly everything she does, which prompts Yoshiko Hanabatake to see her as a fellow "idiot". Much like Akuru Akutsu (Ruri's older brother), Ruri dislikes Yoshiko and she is mortified at the idea of becoming just like her.

Unlike Yoshiko, Ruri has a good amount of common sense, though sometimes her childishness will come out at points.
Yoshiko's homeroom teacher. She tries to teach Yoshiko but to no avail.

The leader of a trio of gyaru classmates whom Yoshiko starts interacting with later in the series. She doesn't really like her, but she's just as dumb as Yoshiko in school. Akane has red hair and is the most antagonistic of the three against Yoshiko. She dislikes Akuru, who calls her ugly. She also wants to be more popular and have a boyfriend.

Akane is a hot-headed girl who often hangs out in her friend's small group and she despises Yoshiko Hanabatake so much that she often takes her anger out on her.
The second of the gyaru classmates. She has short blond hair.

The third of the gyaru classmates. She has long dark hair. She is only one of the three who has a boyfriend, although she is extremely shy about it. Kuroko is a usually calm and collected girl who is often seen as socializing with Akane Eimura and Kii Hiiragi.

She is a member of the disciplinary committee.

As disciplinary committee president, Fuki has a serious personality as she is rather bossy because she was trying to fulfill her role as president, but after she met [Akuru Akutsu](https://anilist.co/character/121875/Akutsu-Akuru), she began to stalk his every move and justifies her actions as concern for Akutsu's well being and her responsibility as the disciplinary committee president.
Mamoru is one of the three who plays with [Yoshiko](https://anilist.co/character/121874/Yoshiko-Hanabatake).
She's rather easily frightened by anything and is as smart as Yoshiko, which isn't saying a lot. She's also rather cheerful.
